description: Live-gap evaluation on test_clips (scripts/live_gap.py for the Python Holistic pipeline, web/scripts/live-gap.mjs for the browser pipeline). Each config changes one setting against the row it names; nothing here was tuned on the clips.

scoring.segment: every classified segment of a clip is scored against the clip's label (top-1 and top-3 of its probabilities)
scoring.clip: the clip's prediction is the mean of its classified segments' probability vectors; a clip without a classified segment counts as wrong
scoring.accepted: a segment is accepted when its top probability reaches the config's threshold; coverage is the accepted share of classified segments, selective accuracy the top-1 accuracy among them

settings.build: head (browser only): the demo as committed in 3fbafa3, built with experiments/head_build_hook.patch, which only records each segment's softmax for the harness; its MediaPipe and classifier run on the page's main thread. Configs without it run the current app with the listed settings
settings.model: v1: the CNN the demo shipped (v1 features); v2: the chosen hybrid (v2 features)
settings.hands: label_inverted: the first demo's handedness mapping (assumes a mirrored frame); nearest_pose_wrist: Holistic's rule (features_spec.json live.hand_assignment)
settings.mirrored: true: landmarks detected on the horizontally flipped frame, as a naive selfie pipeline would (browser only)
settings.aspect: calibrated: k = r_train / r_live over the first 2 s (the first demo's default); frame: k from the frame's width / height and aspect.train_width_over_height; off: k = 1
settings.resampling: index: kept-frame index (training's rule); time: kept-frame clock
settings.segmenter: presence: 3 frames with a hand start, 8 without end, 3 s cap; motion: the motion-energy state machine
settings.decision: raw: softmax and the target-precision threshold (meta.json threshold); calibrated: softmax(logits / temperature) and the net-score threshold (meta.json calibration)
